scope: Two finalized N1 episodes only; each narrow extraction has 16 final P06 source decisions, P07/P08 one each, P09 32 including terminal. No live run or PT read.
read_receipt: First extraction output truncated before analysis; parent permitted one re-extraction of identical windows with in-script reduction.

assumptions.canonical_mapping: rear canonical q = -(degrees(physical q)-standing degrees); q is actual pre-final-dispatch snapshot, not computational proxy
assumptions.same_state_scope: Reachability uses the unique ACTUAL mapper/geometry/controller baseline and previous ACK history; not a counterfactual trajectory or alternate contact solution.
assumptions.interval_scope: Static ranges ignore residual slew but include actual same-tick headroom and hard bounds. One-tick intervals additionally intersect prior REQUEST plus/minus0.5 and final-drive plus/minus1.25. They do not model future mapper feedback, base motion or contacts.
assumptions.finite_latent: Intervals use closed cap extrema as a generous outer bound. Outside remains impossible with finite tanh latent; inside does not establish controllability or physics.
assumptions.timing: Joint q/previous ACK are pre-dispatch of the last physical tick; current contact and task history are post-physics decision-end samples. Native control tick differs from episode tick by reset/prime offset.
assumptions.unavailable: Quaternion/RPY and individual body collision contact/force are not in these decision audit rows; body angular velocity/speed are available, but cannot reconstruct precise attitude or FALL cause.
assumptions.static_interval_limit: Static_keep_intervals are the unslewed candidate target envelope for the actual same-tick baseline. They test ability to sustain/express an inherited target; a previous final target can temporarily remain outside this envelope because final slew retains history. Do not interpret static exclusion as a discontinuous final target jump.

source_notes.observed: P08 continuously changes RL hip 6.9→31.2. P09 source first raises RR hip 0→55.6, then changes knee 0→−37.8 at source +0.667..1.0s, then hip 55.6→−6.9 at +1.133..1.867s. This is command sequencing, not a kinematic assertion about world-z.

Continuous layers keep their clocks; later ownership covers touched channels. Observed one-decision P07/P08 transitions leave finite channel changes active during P09; they do not imply phase-reset state replacement.
Rear hip/knee caps remain ±24/±36 deg through P06–P13; requested servo slew remains 60 deg/s (0.5/tick), final servo slew 150 deg/s (1.25/tick), original hard bounds and 2 deg reserve unchanged.
measured_q in this report is reconstructed from actual_measured_physical_rad with rear standing/sign mapping, never from the computational tracking proxy.

conclusions: No native target verification failure was found in either selected 50-row window. All 32 P09 rows in each run preserve requested rear residual through headroom; actual request-to-effective clipping count is zero.

The proposed positive inherited RR knee vs negative P09 knee exclusion is not observed: both inherited RR knee final targets and actual measured knees remain in the static P09 envelopes throughout both windows.

A narrower hip authority limitation is observed. The early-AIR inherited RR hip final target is outside the static envelope in 17/32 and 14/32 P09 rows; the inherited RL support-hip target is outside in 32/32 rows. These are baseline motion plus unchanged caps, not a cap reduction or forced zero reset.

The immediately previous actual final target stays inside the static cap envelope on all nonterminal sampled P09 ticks. Adding the true previous requested residual slew and final-target slew makes exact one-tick holding impossible on some sampled RR ticks (hip 7/5; knee 2/1). This is a same-prestate local feasibility result, not an alternate trajectory.

Sampling direction also matters: block3 at t4952 actually requests +16.344 deg RR hip while sustaining the inherited target would need -27.987 deg. Not every observed motion is forced by the missing range.

Temporal evidence does not establish FALL causality: block1 RR ground return/Q revocation precedes RR static hip exclusion; block3 already has large angular motion before P09 and peaks at first P09 before static exclusion. Neither run provides a controlled alternative or complete body attitude/contact-force reconstruction in these bounded decision rows.
